segments.he: מַתְנִי' הַחֵרֶשֶׁת, וְהַשּׁוֹטָה, וְהַסּוֹמָא, וְשֶׁנִּטְרְפָה דַּעְתָּהּ — אִם יֵשׁ לָהֶם פִּקְּחוֹת, מְתַקְּנוֹת אוֹתָן, וְהֵן אוֹכְלוֹת בִּתְרוּמָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of a woman «who is deaf [haḥereshet], or an imbecile, or blind, or who went insane,» and is therefore unable to examine herself reliably, «if» such women «have competent» friends, those friends «prepare them» by examining them and immersing them in a ritual bath. «And» on that basis the incompetent women «may partake of teruma» after the sun sets.

moves.summary: competent women prepare a deaf, imbecile, blind or insane woman, who may then eat teruma

positions.claim: competent women examine and immerse a deaf, imbecile, blind or insane woman, who may then eat teruma
